subtitles.en: So that, I think, lays a relatively constructive picture for June, and especially at the time when we're about to look at at least a second quarter and think about whether the policymakers are about to do something.

subtitles.en: Do you think it's soft enough to you think for them to do anything?

subtitles.en: Well, to be honest, the PMI doesn't really tell the story.
subtitles.zh: 老实说，PMI并不能说明全部问题。

subtitles.en: We have to wait until two weeks later when we look at the third quarter data together with the June Activity Growth Indicators.
subtitles.zh: 我们必须等到两周后，结合6月活动增长指标来看三季度数据。

subtitles.en: At the moment, I think PMI tells us that on the supply side, things are okay, but we already know that. Think about exports, think about IP. They have been pretty resilient for some time.
subtitles.zh: 目前PMI告诉我们供给端尚可，但这已是已知信息。出口和工业产出已持续韧性一段时间。

subtitles.en: So the question is really on the demand side, consumption and investment, as I've just said.
subtitles.zh: 所以问题真正在于需求侧，即消费和资本开支。

subtitles.en: And so what are we tracking here in terms of this K-shaped? I mean, it seems like out of all the economy we talk about, you're seeing it much more wider, this K of an economy, is the macro story that we're seeing around Asia?
subtitles.zh: 那么我们在K型复苏方面追踪什么？似乎在我们讨论的所有经济体中，这种K型分化更为广泛，这是亚洲的宏观故事吗？

clips.speaker: Helen Chao
clips.title: 美银乔虹：亚洲分化严重，AI与非科技冰火两重天

subtitles.en: Well, it's probably different from the market. I think the market only cares about the AI and the related parafrost sectors.
subtitles.zh: 这可能与市场看法不同。我认为市场只关心AI及相关领域。

subtitles.en: But actually for EMAsia, we're looking at basically gross diverging. So the front runners are the tech exports, exporters, such as Taiwan and also Korea, a little bit of Japan and China as well.
subtitles.zh: 但对于新兴亚洲，我们看到的是严重分化。领先的是科技出口经济体，如台湾、韩国，以及部分日本和中国。

subtitles.en: But at the same time, we also have the other countries, for example, those in Southeast Asia and in South Asia that struggle a little bit because they are more demand oriented.
subtitles.zh: 但同时，东南亚和南亚国家则较为挣扎，因为它们更依赖需求。

subtitles.en: And they also, you know, relies more on imports of energy. And now with oil prices still relatively elevated, hopefully in the near future is coming down a little bit further, they are seeing more struggle in terms of the gross pressure at a time when inflation is about to edge up.
subtitles.zh: 它们也更依赖能源进口。油价仍相对高位，希望未来会进一步回落，这些国家面临更大的增长压力，同时通胀即将上行。

subtitles.en: On oil, I mean, what was interesting was how it came out that the oil demand, the imports for China, was not as high as some maybe had expected amid the war.
subtitles.zh: 关于石油，有趣的是中国石油需求进口并未如一些人在战争期间预期的那么高。

clips.speaker: Helen Chao
clips.title: 美银乔虹：中国应对高油价有三大优势
title_lines: 中国应对高油价有三大优势

subtitles.en: Well, I think the oil prices staying at elevated levels are presenting some gross challenges, not only to China, but also the rest of Asia in general.
subtitles.zh: 我认为油价持续高位给中国乃至整个亚洲带来增长挑战。

subtitles.en: But for China, I think it is better prepared because of the following reasons. Number one, it has a large strategic reserve so that they can draw upon when things get hotter.
subtitles.zh: 但中国准备更充分，原因如下：第一，拥有大规模战略储备，可在形势紧张时动用。

subtitles.en: And two, they also have more diversified origins where sources of energy. And therefore, they are less impacted by GCC country issues and the transportation through the straight up for most.
subtitles.zh: 第二，能源来源更多元化，因此受海湾国家问题及霍尔木兹海峡运输影响较小。

subtitles.en: But number three, I think also very importantly, China has developed a lot of renewable energies in the recent past. So, you know, I would say that is contributing a lot to the more diversified energy demand that China currently has.
subtitles.zh: 第三，也是非常重要的一点，中国近年来大力发展可再生能源，这极大地促进了能源需求多元化。

subtitles.en: So we are about to see that when oil prices come down, it will help China, you know, get inflation a little bit lower, especially coming from the energy part. We need the good inflation, not the energy inflation, right?
subtitles.zh: 因此，当油价下跌时，将有助于中国降低通胀，尤其是能源部分。我们需要的是良性通胀，而非能源通胀。

subtitles.en: But at the same time, you know, in addition to that terms of trade gain, we are also seeing that China could potentially, you know, see a little bit of upside for corporate and also for household when the energy prices are lower so that demand can recover better.
subtitles.zh: 同时，除了贸易条件改善，能源价格下降还可能提振企业和家庭，从而更好地恢复需求。

clips.title: 美银乔虹：供需缺口待弥合，7月会议或成政策催化剂

subtitles.en: The key is to see the gap between supply and demand. At the moment, supply is relatively resilient as we just mentioned and that's particularly supported by external demand rather than domestic demand.
subtitles.zh: 关键在于供需缺口。目前供给相对韧性，主要受外需而非内需支撑。

subtitles.en: But if we can get domestic demand back, especially on the investment side because it's faster, investment has a higher volatility compared to consumption.
subtitles.zh: 但如果能提振内需，尤其是资本开支方面，因为其速度更快，且波动性高于消费。

subtitles.en: So our hope is that we can see a little bit better fixed asset investment. We still hold the view that for the full year fixed asset investment growth can be as high as 2% in average.
subtitles.zh: 我们希望看到固定资产开支改善。我们仍认为全年固定资产开支增速平均可达2%。

subtitles.en: And in terms of your growth forecast, you still think 4.5% for this year? It's probably going to be driven by exports you still think. Mostly.
subtitles.zh: 关于增长预测，您仍认为今年4.5%？主要由出口驱动？是的。

subtitles.en: We were holding very high hopes for rebalancing, but that hope has dashed. And we're now saying that it's mostly driven by exports and export growth this year can be as high as 15% nominal terms.
subtitles.zh: 我们曾对再平衡寄予厚望，但希望破灭。现在我们认为增长主要由出口驱动，今年出口名义增速可能高达15%。

subtitles.en: I mean, you're saying, obviously, with the supply size still looking strong, exports looking strong, that it could actually delay this whole next round of stimulus from the government.
subtitles.zh: 您是说，供给端依然强劲，出口强劲，这可能会推迟政府下一轮刺激措施。

subtitles.en: Is the polypure meeting in July going to be a good catalyst, or at least an opportunity to look at measures there, or do we have to wait a few months as you say, maybe more data sets?
subtitles.zh: 7月的重要会议是否会成为良好催化剂，或至少是审视措施的契机，还是如您所说需等待数月、更多数据？
